# Lionheart Fixt 0.9.0 - the Temple District

Refuse to partner with Machiavelli in Barcelona and he tells you, in the shipped game, that
you've *"forced me to seek aid from those that seek to do us harm."* Save him and he promises to
repay his debt in Montaillou. Both endings were written. He is on no Montaillou map, and nothing
in the game ever called either one.

**Fixt** is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt: it fixes
what is broken, restores what was cut, and adds new content only where the game plainly ran out.

This is the first release to touch Act 3, and the first in a while where the riskiest pieces
were played through before shipping.

## Machiavelli keeps his word, or his threat

He's at the Montaillou inn now. Refuse him and he gloats, walks out, and the Old Man's assassins
come in behind him - real ones, harder than the town guard. Save him and he pays what he owes
and warns you what's coming. Let him die and he isn't there. (The Inquisition agent at the far
table will turn on you if you cast spirit magic during the fight. That's not a bug; that's the
Inquisition.)

## Na Roqua counts her friends

Promise the witch of Montaillou you'll spare the Cathars and the game marks you a
*cathar friend* - a flag it ships, checks, and never sets. So *"Welcome spiritbearer and Cathar
friend"* never played, and neither did the two voiced lines behind it, where she admits she once
hunted beside the shapeshifting daeva and tells you where the thing that can kill it is kept. All
of it plays now, and the branch opens the cave it describes.

## Torquemada acknowledges his own

Kill the Goblin Khan as an Inquisitor and he gave you the outsider's speech. The member's was
written and unreachable. You hear it now.

## Read and left alone

Torquemada has a second task written and voiced: purify the shadow dryad of Montaillou. It was
never wired, and the read shows why - the shadow dryad is Na Roqua, and she cannot be killed;
ten thousand hit points, an armour class of a thousand, and attacking her throws you out of her
house. Unfinished, not cut. It stays dark, with the full account in the repo.

## Smaller things

Sir Auric sponsors a tainted initiate in the words written for one. Lord Javier tells an
unsponsored petitioner to seek Auric. Javier can tell you about the Sacred Lance. Cervantes
remembers you. And everything from the 0.8.1-0.8.4 repair releases is here too.

## Before you install

The Montaillou pieces need a character who has **not yet entered the inn or the witch's house**;
Cervantes needs one who hasn't entered the Temple District. The Khan report and the Templar
dialogue work on any save.

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over 0.8.4 as normal.
